revision_reason: The original 2019 start truncates the prior-cycle demand, price, capex, project and expectation setup needed to explain 2019-2020 outcomes without hindsight.
selective_antecedent_rule: Before 2015, backfill only material antecedents needed to explain an actor, project, contract, technology, policy or metric inside the primary horizon.

added_time_slice_passes.focus: early demand/policy acceleration, project sanctioning, capital response and technology expectations that later shaped supply
questions: What demand, policy and technology expectations caused companies to commit capital or offtake before the later cycle peak?
Which projects, expansions, financing structures and customer commitments were created here but became visible as supply only years later?
Which actors, product names, statistics and market terms from this period are easy to miss when searching from a 2019 vocabulary?

added_time_slice_passes.focus: high-price/high-expectation phase, accelerated expansion, chemistry-route expectations and the beginning of reversal
questions: What did participants believe about demand growth, lithium scarcity, chemistry share, project timing and sustainable prices before the reversal?
Which capex, mine/converter/material/cell projects and contracts were committed under those expectations?
Which leading signs of oversupply, inventory, policy change, margin pressure or project slippage were observable at the time without hindsight?

seal_rule.additional_requirement: A high-value shard cannot be considered historically complete if its 2015-2018 setup contains a material uncovered causal dimension.
